questions.label: Ranked Wins
questions.prompt: Since 2020, which school has more wins over AP-ranked opponents, and how many?
questions.reveal: Clemson 11, South Carolina 8 (through 2025). Latest: Clemson: 2023 vs. No. 22 North Carolina 31–20, 2024 vs. No. 8 SMU 34–31, 2025 vs. No. 19 Louisville 20–19; South Carolina: 2024 vs. No. 24 Vanderbilt 28–7, 2024 vs. No. 24 Missouri 34–30, 2024 vs. No. 12 Clemson 17–14.

info.title: What counts as a ranked win?
info.text: A win over a team in the AP Top 25 the week of the game (bowls use the last regular-season poll), regular season and postseason, through 2025.

questions.label: Twist
questions.prompt: Travis Etienne finished 9th in Heisman voting in 2019. How many rushing yards did he have when No. 3 Clemson beat South Carolina that year?
questions.reveal: 🔄 Twist: just 51 on 15 carries, against a season of 1,614 (about 124 a game). Clemson won 38–3 anyway.
